name: UWF Starrcade

matches.note: World Women's Title; Phoenix won with a small package. NEW CHAMPION.
Second RKO, pin.
The Unprettier, pin.
Neidhart's interference draws a disqualification; Batista advances by DQ, no clean singles finish.
Scorpion Death Drop, pin.
World Women's Tag Team Title; Ivory & Molly won via sunset flip on Aja Kong. NEW CHAMPIONS (3rd reign of the title for this Ivory/Molly pairing). Luna Vachon seconded the champions.
Piledriver, pin (Col. Robert Parker seconded Windham).
Power bomb, pin (billed as John Bradshaw Layfield here).
Tombstone, pin.
Flair won by DQ (Chyna's interference, right after Abyss hit the Black Hole Slam) — Flair never legally pinned.
The Rock won via rollup/tights (Pat Patterson & Gerald Brisco's interference backfired on Umaga).
Larry Zbyszko ran in; brawl to the back, no bell/decision given.
Bad News Brown won via rollup after Bigelow missed a diving headbutt.
Andre's elbow drop on Booger, pin.
Orton won by DQ (Andre the Giant interfered on Cage's behalf).
Hart Foundation interference draws a no-contest; Randy Orton receives a bye to the finals as a result.
Flair won via a fluke rollup when the Undertaker's knee buckled mid-Tombstone attempt; Mr. Perfect assists Flair's escape after.
Clothesline From Hell, pin.

US Title; Noble won with a rolling DDT off the top rope. NEW CHAMPION. (The fed's own title-history ledger records this reign under 'December \'09' — an internal typo for December 2008, given the chain that follows.)
The Firm (DiBiase Jr & Rhodes) retain — DiBiase Jr's top-rope belt shot on Bubba Ray (Brother Ray), pin.
Triple H and Shawn Michaels run in and forcibly end the match — no winner, interrupted.

notes: The scheduled final (Randy Orton vs. Ric Flair vs. JBL, no-holds-barred triple threat for the vacant World Heavyweight Championship) is never fought on the page: Vince McMahon arrives, a riot breaks out over the Stephanie McMahon kidnapping subplot, and police shut the event down ("Starrcade 2009 has been shut down") before the bell. The fed's own title-history ledger separately resolves the tournament at a later, uncaptured show ('UWF Brand New Fear, Jan '09') -- see reigns.json's uwf-uwow-world-r008, whose own event field already pointed there rather than at this show.

matches.note: World Tag Team Title; the Firm retains via the Million Dollar Dream/High Impact combo on Venis (IRS run-in). Post-match: Faarooq & Bradshaw (APA/Acolytes) return, attack the Firm.
MVP won after a hooded Owen Hart clubbed Batista from behind and rolled MVP on top — Owen Hart reveal, Hart Foundation angle.
Jillian Hall rolled up Nakano after a missed leg drop — an upset.
Black Hole Slam, pin (Chyna seconded Abyss).
World Women's Tag Team Title; champions retain via a figure-4 submission on Moolah.
Cruiserweight Title; Styles won with a small package. RETAINS. Punk assaults Styles with the belt and a GTS post-match.
Samoan Spike, then a big splash, pin.
US Title; Race won via Indian Deathlock submission. NEW CHAMPION.
Shattered Dreams on Patterson, pin. Post-match: Bastien Booger & Damien Demento attack Goldust; Dusty Rhodes makes the save.
World Women's Title; Phoenix retained with a clothesline after a Sunny distraction against Sable. RETAINS.

matches.stipulation: Hall-of-Famer bonus match (winner enters the Skydome Rumble field)
matches.note: Volkoff's back breaker on Morton, pin.

World Heavyweight Title; Orton won by count-out — Bobby Heenan appeared to help Andre but instead stalled/distracted him, letting Orton recover and roll back in while Andre was preoccupied; Andre counted out. RETAINS. Heenan's true loyalties left ambiguous.

eliminations.note: Double count-out with Kurt Angle, brawling to the floor — both champions eliminated together.
Double count-out with Triple H (see above).
Shawn Michaels hit Sweet Chin Music on Nash, Flair made the pin.
Knocked out and carried out after a Shane McMahon baseball-bat attack — written out, not a formal elimination.
Rollup, fistful of tights, pin — Jarrett is the sole survivor for Team TNA.

matches.note: Ultimo Dragon defeated Chris Candido with a standing blockbuster.
Intercontinental Title on the line; Warrior pinned Steiner after a Warrior Splash. RETAINS.
Harry Smith upset Booker T with a German suplex.
Curt Hennig won by count-out after thumbing Andre's eyes and diving off the apron.
Martel forced a submission with the Boston Crab but the referee reversed it to a DQ win for Shark Boy after Martel piledrove him twice more; Vampiro made the save.
World Women's Tag Team Title; Trish/Gail won via Twist of Fate on Luna. NEW CHAMPIONS.
Samoa Joe won by Coquina Clutch submission.

eliminations.note: Counted out after accidentally being hit by Jake Roberts.

matches.note: Roberts/Earthquake/Typhoon survive as the winning team (Allen eliminated by count-out mid-match, team still wins).
Hassan won via referee stoppage (Camel Clutch) with Sheik Adnan El Kaisse and Shawn Daivari interference; no submission was actually given.

Dustin Rhodes refused to wrestle and installed Barry Windham (w/ Ric Flair, Baby Doll) as a replacement opponent for Cody. Windham nearly finished Cody with a superplex but Dusty Rhodes broke the pin with a Bionic Elbow, drawing a disqualification on Cody. Post-match beatdown by the Horsemen.
US Tag Team Title; Demolition retains by DQ after a run-in from Earthquake, Typhoon, Greg Valentine and Lex Luger attacking Demolition post-bell. Mr. Fugi's defection to Money Inc backfires.
Moolah won with a piledriver.
World Tag Team Title (interfed shared belt reference; UWF-uwow's own Owen Hart/Jarrett reign continues); Owen Hart submitted Grunge with the Sharpshooter, Debra distracted Rocco Rock.
World Women's Title; Nakano retains by count-out after Sherri Martel shoved Jazz off the apron.
Flair won by Figure-4 submission; huge brawl after (Horsemen vs. Sting's Army: Road Warriors, Rhodes Family, Magnum TA).

Won via DQ after Jake Roberts interfered and DDT'd Dynamite Kid; Davey Boy is spared elimination by the DQ finish, but the stipulation still credited Dynamite Kid the win. Owen Hart then helped Davey Boy Smith double-suplex Dynamite Kid through a chair, a shock reunion/heel turn.
Canadian Heavyweight Title; Storm won by Maple Leaf submission. NEW CHAMPION.

Hopkins-ordered impromptu tag. Ends in a double-turn: Davey Boy Smith joins Owen Hart to chair-assisted double-suplex Dynamite Kid; no clean finish shown for the match itself, treated as unresolved/angle-heavy.
Cruiserweight Title; Styles retrieved the belt after Justin Credible's Singapore Cane shot hit Waltman by mistake. RETAINS.
Television Title; both men counted out (Malenko had the Texas Cloverleaf on Rude outside the ring). Rude retains (no title change on double count-out).
Kip pinned Jones with the Famasser.
Both men counted out after a suicide dive; no finish.
World Heavyweight Title; both counted out after Hogan/Savage ringside distraction (Lesnar and Cage then turn and clothesline Hogan/Savage together). Cage retains (no title change on count-out).
Six-man; Fatu pinned Bigelow with the Fatu-Driver after Afa's interference.
Rhyno speared Yokozuna out through the ropes for a count-out, the only clean elimination the served text details; Rhyno's team is credited the win.
Akeem (One Man Gang) pinned Albright with the 747 Splash.
US Title; Storm won with a Tombstone Piledriver after a Miss Jackie chair shot. NEW CHAMPION.
Banzai Splash, pin.
James Gang won; IRS clobbered Orndorff with a briefcase after DiBiase tried to bribe him, Kip covers for the pin.
Bad News Brown (billed here as Bad News Allen's aka) won with the Ghetto Blaster/inziguri kick.
Tyson Tomko ran in and attacked Cody Rhodes, drawing a disqualification; AJ Styles/Tomko revealed as a new heel alliance.
Akebono pinned Windham with a Big Splash — upset over a Horseman.
Nakano won with the Guillotine Leg Drop.
World Midget Title; Little Beaver retained with a top-rope splash. RETAINS. Post-match, King Kong Bundy attacked both Beaver and Mae Young (Big Splash on Mae) — angle/beatdown, no title change.
Rude won with the Payoff (Miss Brooks interference).
Moolah won via back-suplex-into-pinning-combo, earning a World Women's Title shot.
747 Splash, pin.
World Women's Title; Sherri won with the Rude Awakening (feet on ropes). RETAINS.
Pillman won with a double chair power bomb; post-match Pillman calls out Steve Austin.
World Tag Team Title; both legal men counted out after the Horsemen fled — Horsemen retain (no title change).

Winner earns a World Title shot at Bad Blood. Flair retrieved the briefcase/contract. Post-match beatdown of Flair & Sting by Abyss/Dustin Rhodes/Chyna (Hopkins-orchestrated); the Horsemen (Anderson/Blanchard/Windham) refuse to help Flair, revealed in league with Hopkins.
World Heavyweight Title; Angle won by Ankle Lock submission after a backup referee took over when Hopkins was knocked out. NEW CHAMPION.
US Title; Storm won by DQ (Dustin Rhodes ran in with a kendo stick). RETAINS.
Paul Roma turned on Orndorff for a DiBiase payoff, leaving him laid out; no clean pinfall shown — interference finish, Pretty Wonderful implodes.
Too Cool vs. Page & Hennig (w/ Bam Bam Bigelow); Page hit the Diamond Cutter on Taylor for the pin.
Banzai Splash, pin (Mr. Fuji seconded Yokozuna).
World Women's Tag Team Title; champions retain by DQ (spiked piledriver on Matsumoto after a ropes-break spot).
Wildcat Chris Harris' UWF debut; Sharpshooter submission.
Six-man; Bad News Brown (Allen Coage) accidentally levels his own partner Rude, letting Eric Young get the pinfall.
Figure-4 submission (BG James seconded Kip).
The Unprettier, pin. Cage accepts Hopkins' Dynasty offer of employment (angle).
World Women's Title; Sherri won with an elbow smash from the middle rope. RETAINS.
Cody wins by DQ (Chyna ran in, low-blowed Dusty Rhodes, then Dustin+Chyna hit a spiked piledriver on Dusty).
Public Enemy's UWF comeback; Grunge's chair shot sends Bundy through a table, pin (Mae Young/Little Beaver ringside).
IRS won with a knee drop, feet on the ropes for leverage.
Trish won with the Stratusfaction Bulldog on Richter; earns a Sherri Martel title shot.
Sabu won with a springboard leg drop.

World Tag Team Title; Road Warriors won when Hawk hit the Doomsday Device on Blanchard, pin. NEW CHAMPIONS. Interference from Akebono/Yokozuna, and finally Ric Flair (preventing a Horsemen title-belt DQ escape) both factor in.
Chyna pinned Sting with a Pedigree after a Dustin Rhodes steel-pipe run-in — gang-beating finish.
Cruiserweight Title; Styles won with the Styles Clash (Tomko interference). RETAINS.

matches.stipulation: Earl Hebner announced as special guest referee, but Bret Hart attacks Hebner pre-match and he never officiates
matches.note: World Heavyweight Title; Flair won when the substitute referee (tripped by Christian Cage's ringside interference) controversially ruled Angle submitted — a fluke/disputed finish, not a clean submission. NEW CHAMPION. Bret Hart's shock UWF debut/appearance attacking Earl Hebner (angle only, no bell).
US Title; Storm retained via DDT and a fistful of tights (Jackie low-blow assist). RETAINS. Trevor Murdoch's UWF debut.
Back-Cracker, pin (Tomko chair interference).
Perfect-Plex, pin (Kimberly seconded Page).

matches.stipulation: ICWC World Heavyweight Title (NOT a uwf-uwow title)
matches.note: Jeff Jarrett won the ICWC (not UWF) World Title after a hammer shot to Hogan's knee, Figure-4, and Vince Russo interference/early bell. Out of scope for uwf-uwow's own reigns.json (ICWC's own championship).
Bertha Faye's leg drop assist lets Jackie Moore pin Richter.
World Tag Team Title; DiBiase Jr & Rhodes (with JBL run-in clotheslining Hawk) win — DiBiase Jr's reverse fist drop, pin. NEW CHAMPIONS.

World Women's Title; Sherri attacked pre-bell, brutalized Trish, the referee was bumped, and Beth Phoenix (debut) ran in and attacked Sherri, dragging Trish out — DQ win for Trish, no title change. Trish/Beth Phoenix align.

Ric Flair never appears (a no-show angle); Hopkins/Cage are beaten down roughly 2-on-5, no pinfall shown; the Undertaker debuts standing over the beaten Hopkins as a stinger ending. No result/unresolved, angle-heavy finish.
Demolition Decapitation on Fuji, pin.
Trip to Asbury Park, pin. (Dallas Page seconded Bigelow.)
Aries won by rollup with a foot on the ropes.
Akebono's UWF debut; power slam, pin.
Miss Brooks' fast count for Rude (Payoff on a chair) was not the ref's real count; Smith's small package pin stood.
Pretty Wonderful won via brass knuckles, pin on BG.
Typhoon Splash, pin (One Man Gang billed as Akeem here).
Young won by rollup, an upset.
US Title; Piper won by small package. NEW CHAMPION. Christian Cage ran in after, chasing off Hogan.
Pillman won with a DDT; UWF return.
Jarrett won with the Stroke, after a pre-match ambush by Storm.
World Women's Tag Team Title; Morretti/Greenwald won via Sharpshooter submission on Kim. NEW CHAMPIONS.
Cruiserweight Title; Styles won with the Phenomenon. RETAINS.
Chyna-Doll won with a Pedigree.
Angle won with the Angle Slam after backdropping Abyss through a table; Mae Young ambushed Hopkins ringside as a distraction.

Entry order: Dusty Rhodes, Ric Flair, Dustin Rhodes, Cody Rhodes, Tully Blanchard, Road Warrior Animal, Arn Anderson, Sting, Barry Windham, Road Warrior Hawk. Dusty Rhodes locked the Figure-4 on his own son Dustin Rhodes for the submission win.
World Women's Title; Sherri Martel won with a Brain Buster Suplex on Nakano (Moolah interference). NEW CHAMPION.

World Heavyweight Title; Cage won after Hopkins fast-counted following Hopkins turning on Hogan/Savage (Randy Savage seconded Hogan; Roddy Piper seconded Cage). RETAINS. Post-match: Hopkins fires/trades Hogan and Savage to ICWC.
Andre won with a double underhook suplex (Mae Young Thesz-pressed Bobby Heenan first).
Cutter plus a fistful of tights, pin.
Too Cool squashed; top-rope headbutt on Christopher, pin.
Orndorff pinned Virgil with a piledriver; Orndorff earns a steel-cage match with Ted DiBiase at the Ultimate Supercard.
Madusa won with a German Suplex; declares for the UWF, demands a Women's Title shot.

Cruiserweight Title; Styles won with the Styles Clash, then abandoned/threw down the belt post-match (a new 'era' angle with Tomko) — no formal stripping shown, an honest gap on the title's status after.
Haku submitted Anderson with the Goozle; Anderson's DDT on Hopkins afterward is a face-turn angle.
Jarrett won with the Stroke; Bam Bam Bigelow attacked Page again post-match (Trip to Asbury Park).
Hennig Plex.

World Tag Team Title; Road Warriors win by count-out (Yokozuna and Akebono brawled each other outside the ring). RETAIN. Post-match: Brother Ray & Brother Devon run in, beat down the champions, declare themselves #1 contenders.
World Women's Tag Team Title; Nakano/Matsumoto won with a Frog Splash after a savate kick. NEW CHAMPIONS.
Cage won by rollup after ramming Bret into Hopkins on the apron (fast count). Cage then refused to join Hopkins' Dynasty, hitting the Unprettier on Hopkins.
Flying forearm, pin.
America's Most Wanted (reunited) lose; Rhodes hit the Bionic Elbow on Storm, Piper Sleeper-held Harris. Earns Storm-Piper US title match at the Supercard.
World Women's Title; Sherri won after a reverse DDT, then Moolah's cane swing (meant for Sherri) hit Trish by mistake, pin. RETAINS. Moolah earns a Supercard title shot.

matches.stipulation: 8-man tag (Arn Anderson surprise 4th man, Horsemen reunite w/ Flair)
matches.note: Flair rolled up Sabu for the pin.

eliminations.note: Accidentally chair-shot by Virgil, then Doomsday Device, pin.
Counted out as the Million Dollar Man's troops retreated.

matches.note: Piper/Storm double-countout early (both removed); Hawk & Animal are the sole survivors.
Doink the Clown/Damien Demento/Bastien Booger interfere before Beaver-vs-Dink is decided; King Kong Bundy makes the save. No formal decision shown — an honest gap; Beaver was never pinned.

Jamie Noble wins (superkick eliminates Bad News Brown last). Umaga eliminated 2nd (by Ron Simmons); The Rock eliminated 1st (by Umaga); Sabu self-eliminated (missed Rolling Thunder). Not a title match; Noble earns a US Title shot at Brand New Fear 2009.

eliminations.note: Lights go out, Punk laid out, then Perfect Plex — the attacker unrevealed.

matches.note: Curt Hennig is the sole survivor.
Orton wins by count-out, using Bobby Heenan as a human shield so Andre accidentally clobbers his own manager; Heenan legitimately 'injured' (kayfabe write-out angle).
Sting submitted Regal with the Scorpion Deathlock for the win; Bret Hart and Batista were separately double-DQ'd for brawling to the back (doesn't affect the team result).
Sherri decked the referee and the match was called a no-contest.

matches.stipulation: main event tag (w/ Chyna, Matthew Hopkins ringside)
matches.note: Undertaker pinned Abyss with a Tombstone. Flair sabotaged Cage backstage pre-finish (attacked him off-camera); post-match Triple H & Shawn Michaels (DX) debut, bloody the Undertaker with a sledgehammer, revealing Flair's new alliance with them.
